2023 
Author: Krishan Pahal
Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:166693
Court No. - 72
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2858 of 2022
Applicant :- Smt Sangita Devi
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Pradyumn Kumar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
Heard Sri Pradyumn Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Amit Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.

2. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 0093 of 2021, under Sections 193, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 & 120-B of IPC, Police Station Kurawali, District Mainpuri, with a prayer to enlarge her on anticipatory bail.

3. As per prosecution story, an FIR was instituted by Shakeel Khan against the applicant and other co-accused persons which was registered as Case Crime No.363 of 2016, u/s 279 & 338 of IPC whereby the driver of one motorcycle no. UP84 M 6592 was shown to have collided with the applicant.

The applicant is stated to have been admitted in Medanta Hospital, Gurugram where she underwent treatment for a period of more than five months and it had come up in her statement Smt Sangita Devi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12066485/
1 itself at the time of her admission that she met with an accident by falling down from her scooty which was driven by herself.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It also transpires that Shakeel Khan, the person, who had stated to have driven the motorcycle no. UP84 M 6592, is an immediate neighbour of the applicant and share the boundary wall with her house, as such, the said claim petition and the FIR has been filed with ulterior motive to take compensation under Motor Vehicles Act.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that she has been falsely implicated in the present case although her claim petition was dismissed by the Tribunal but the said dismissal order has been challenged in this Court by filing FAFO which is still pending and no order has been passed on it.
Learned counsel has further stated that there is every likelihood of applicant succeeding in the said FAFO.
The applicant is a lady and was bed ridden for a substantial period of time and had incurred heavy expenses on her treatment at Medanta Hospital, Gurugram.
She has apprehension of her arrest.
It is further submitted that the applicant has no criminal history.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed, she will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.
6. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail on the ground that it is an open and shut case.

The applicant in collusion with the driver of motorcycle no. UP84 M 6592 which was owned by Madhav Mishra and was shown to be driven by Shakeel Khan, has made a false claim for getting compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act and after taking into consideration the said fact, Tribunal has passed reasoned order while dismissing her claim petition.

7. After hearing the parties and taking into consideration the fact that the menace of filing false claim petitions is on a rise and the present case seems to be a classic example of the said offence committed by the applicant just to take compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act, therefore, I do not find it a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

8. In view of the above, the present anticipatory bail application is found devoid of merits and is,
accordingly, rejected.

(Justice Krishan Pahal) Order Date :- 18.8.2023 Siddhant  Smt Sangita Devi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12066485/
